m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You'll be surprised to hear it, but I actually waited for you to finish this. You've worked so hard, I wanted to at least give you a chance.
Really? You'd risk your Master Plan of destroying the Spiral just for the opportunity to rub our noses in it?
I would. It's one of the prerogatives of being a Primal Divine Force. I can be as petty and absurd as I want.
But look at you, young lady! All grown up, confident and outspoken. Another drop of potential lost amid this sea of mediocrity.
And you, Wizard, with you, I feel a special kinship at this point. That's why I've prepared a gift of sorts, a surprise from your past.
Using the Eye of History, I found a few creatures who sorely hoped to see you again. You'll find them guarding the Chronoshards.
If you manage to overcome each of them, I'll be waiting with the Eye of History. You might want to be quick. Time is slipping away!
I can't believe this! When Grandfather Spider dragged me from the grave, I thought he was pulling my leg, and he was! Ha!
But how could I pass up even a remote chance to face you again? And with Shadow Magic? If only I had this before! Come! Give me my vengeance!
Was that the guy from Unicorn Way? Wow! When Grandfather Spider said he was digging up the past, I never dreamed he'd go THAT far back!
I wonder who's next. Grab that Chronoshard and let's go to the next Dune!
<ITALICS>As you collect the Chronoshard, it dissolves one of the Shadow Rays that was projected into the Sands of Time. <ITALICS>
You! You stole all my fame and glory... and with no showmanship whatsoever! Now, I will finally get my rematch, and prove I am the best warrior!
So... have you noticed I'm a little more helpful than before? Oh, ok. Good, I kept waiting for you to say something...
Not that I'm trying to take all the credit, of course. You still seem to be holding your own... but hey, we're better together, right?
Sorry. I'm veering into sappy land again, aren't I? Let's just get the Chronoshard and head to the next dune.
<ITALICS>As you collect the Chronoshard, it dissolves another one of the Shadow Rays that was projected into the Sands of Time. <ITALICS>
Brillig is past, and arrived is my hour. You once took my Hearts, but left my head. Now I've grown in power. This time, you will be dead!
O frabjous day! Callooh! Callay! Yep, I know all that stuff. Baba Yaga has a thing for fairy tales and weird poems.
I'm not complaining though. It comes in handy at times like these. Gives me something clever to say, at least.
All right, get that last Chronoshard and then meet me back outside. Then we'll go and finally face Grandfather Spider.
<ITALICS>As you collect the Chronoshard, it dissolves the third Shadow Ray that was projected into the Sands of Time. Only one remains. <ITALICS>
It looks like whatever hold the Shadow Magic has on the Sands of Time is weakened, but there's just that one final strand.
I'll remain here to keep the Chronoverge from falling back into the Cabal's Clutches. I'd be little help down there anyhow.
Take the portal down and do whatever you must to reclaim the Chronoshards and the Eye of History. That should reset the Sands.
Whatever power my wishes may have, I send them along with you. The fate of Mirage and all the Spiral hangs in the balance. Godspeed, Wizard.
Much as I enjoy polite conversation, I hardly think this is the time for an extended discourse, Wizard.
